question: Who among the following science fiction/ popular science writers wrote ‘2001: A Space Odyssey’ and held the position of a Professor at the Physical Research Laboratory, Ahmedabad?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arthur C Clarke.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arthur Charles Clarke**** was an author and inventor, most famous for his science fiction novel '2001: A Space Odyssey.'**
 
• His work ranged from scientific discovery to science fiction, from technical application to entertainment.
 
• Arthur C Clarke, a** famous science fiction writer** held the position of a** professor at the Physical Research Laboratory in Ahmedabad.**
 
• He was also a** radar instructor in the Royal Air Force **after** World War II **began in the **year 1939.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Isaac Asimov**

 
 
• ​Isaac Asimov was an** American writer and professor of biochemistry **at Boston University.
 
• A prolific writer who is** best known for the Foundation series and robot stories.**
 
 
 
• **Jules Verne **
 
 
• ​Jules Verne was a** French novelist, poet, and playwright. **
 
• Famous for his pioneering **science-fiction novels,** such as **Journey to the Centre of the Earth (1864), From the Earth to the Moon (1865), and Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea (1869–70).**
 
 
 
• **HG Wells ****​**
 
 
• **​H.G. Wells was an English novelist, journalist, sociologist, and historian.**
 
• Best known for such** science fiction novels as The Time Machine and The War of the Worlds and such comic novels as Tono-Bungay.**
